trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller-supplied output path may reach PHP filesystem stat calls (file_exists/is_file/is_dir/unlink) through a stream wrapper; decided by a case-sensitive 'phar://' prefix check in AbstractGenerator::prepareOutput, replaced by a scheme allow-list (['file']) with a Windows drive-letter exception.

landing_point.why: The summary names the output filename and the CVE-2023-28115 'phar://' check; the only phar string in src/ is this strpos test in prepareOutput.

fix_sites.entry_point: same (new protected helper isProtocolAllowed called from prepareOutput)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All published changes are in src/AbstractGenerator.php prepareOutput; no second implementation, wrapper or save/reload site in the fix.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Option values are documented as unvalidated caller responsibility (src/AbstractGenerator.php:400-401), and the advisory names only the output filename, so the is_file() stat on attachment/stylesheet values in Pdf::handleArrayOptions can be argued out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Plain relative/absolute local paths, explicit file:// URLs and Windows drive-letter paths (C:\out.pdf, parsed by parse_url as a one-letter scheme) must remain valid output targets; for options, local file paths and http/https URLs must keep working while inline CSS/attachment content is written to temp files.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: attachment/stylesheet option values (string or array) reach is_file() via Pdf::handleArrayOptions before any scheme check, so a phar:// / PHAR:// value is stat'ed by PHP
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Options are documented as unvalidated (src/AbstractGenerator.php:400-401) and the advisory only mentions the output filename; the separate SSRF fix already covers option URLs for file_get_contents.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file (src/Pdf.php subclass) from landing point in src/AbstractGenerator.php; same package

O8_uncovered_routes.route: binary path from constructor/setBinary reaches is_executable() (a stat) without a scheme check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Binary is developer configuration, not user input.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: temporary folder from setTemporaryFolder reaches is_dir()/mkdir()/is_writable() without a scheme check

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second output-like path (e.g. an 'attachment' save path or cache-folder option) checked with file_exists before passing to WeasyPrint
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: handleArrayOptions already probes option values with isFile; a maintainer adding a cache-folder existence check (option exists at src/Pdf.php:161) would naturally reuse fileExists/isDir.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a checkOutput-style post-write check on a user-chosen path used by a new save helper that skips prepareOutput
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: checkOutput calls fileExists/filesize on $output independently of prepareOutput; a new public save/copy helper could call it directly.

O9_family: CWE-502 PHAR deserialization via stream-wrapper path reaching filesystem stat functions (incomplete case-sensitive denylist)

O10_build.toolchain: composer + phpunit ^9.6 (PHP 7.4-8.5); phar metadata deserialization on stat only on PHP < 8.0
O10_build.project_tests: tests/Unit/AbstractGeneratorTest.php (testFailingGenerateWithOutputContainingPharPrefix at :957), tests/Unit/PdfTest.php (option handling); WeasyPrint binary not needed for unit tests (mocks)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Make the phar:// prefix check case-insensitive (stripos) in prepareOutput only, leaving other wrappers and the option-value is_file() route open.

out_of_scope_notes: removeTemporaryFiles realpath() on public $temporaryFiles (src/AbstractGenerator.php:338) - previous advisory, realpath does not use wrappers.
'format' option concatenated into the shell command unescaped (src/Pdf.php:209-211) - separate injection concern, not pursued.
unverified: Repo size in MB not measured (only 7 source files; clearly under 5 MB).
